summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings and developments in the retail sector, particularly focusing on regulatory actions and corporate governance.

bullets.text: Karnataka lawyers demand a 10-year prison term for offences against lawyers amid protests over recent advocate killings.
The Supreme Court has requested a response from UP Police regarding an attack on lawyers in a Ghaziabad society.
The Allahabad High Court has ordered an FIR against a woman for falsely accusing her brother of raping her daughter.
FirstClub has crossed 3.5 million orders and is entering the beauty and personal care segment with over 700 products.
GIVA has raised over $100 million and aims for Rs 1250 crore revenue in FY27, focusing on store expansion and manufacturing.
